list_clrs_30_algorithms: list all 30 CLRS benchmark algorithms from the CLRS_30_ALGS constant
lookup_algorithm_spec: lookup the probe spec for a given algorithm like dijkstra or bfs in SPECS
inspect_stage_constants: inspect the Stage class constants INPUT OUTPUT and HINT for algorithm dataflow stages
inspect_type_constants: inspect the Type class constants like SCALAR MASK and POINTER for probe data types
check_algorithm_sample_settings: check the num_samples_multiplier setting for a specific algorithm in CLRS_30_ALGS_SETTINGS
